properties.name: agentcore.memory.total-events-limit
properties.description: Maximum number of short-term memory events to retrieve.

deprecation.reason: Moved to the short-term memory namespace for consistency with agentcore.memory.long-term.*. See https://github.com/spring-ai-community/spring-ai-agentcore/issues/49.

properties.name: agentcore.memory.default-session
properties.description: Default session id used when none is supplied in the conversation id.

deprecation.reason: Moved to the short-term memory namespace for consistency with agentcore.memory.long-term.*. See https://github.com/spring-ai-community/spring-ai-agentcore/issues/49.

properties.name: agentcore.memory.page-size
properties.description: Page size used when listing short-term memory events.

deprecation.reason: Moved to the short-term memory namespace for consistency with agentcore.memory.long-term.*. See https://github.com/spring-ai-community/spring-ai-agentcore/issues/49.

properties.name: agentcore.memory.ignore-unknown-roles
properties.description: Whether to silently skip messages with unsupported roles instead of failing.

deprecation.reason: Moved to the short-term memory namespace (see https://github.com/spring-ai-community/spring-ai-agentcore/issues/49); the property itself is also scheduled for removal — skipping non-dialogue messages will become the only behaviour (see https://github.com/spring-ai-community/spring-ai-agentcore/issues/109).

properties.name: agentcore.memory.short-term.ignore-unknown-roles
properties.description: Deprecated. When true (default) non-dialogue messages (e.g. ToolResponseMessage) are skipped with a warning; when false the repository throws on them, which crashes Spring AI 2.0.0-M7+ tool-using turns.

deprecation.reason: Misnamed (TOOL/OTHER are first-class AgentCore Roles, not 'unknown') and the throw-mode has no production use. Skipping non-dialogue messages will become hardcoded behaviour. See https://github.com/spring-ai-community/spring-ai-agentcore/issues/109.

properties.name: agentcore.memory.session.enabled
properties.description: Enable the Spring AI Session API bean stack (AgentCoreSessionRepository, DefaultSessionService, SessionMemoryAdvisor). When false (default) only the legacy ChatMemory stack is auto-configured. REQUIRES the optional dependency 'org.springaicommunity:spring-ai-session-management' on the classpath; without it, no session beans are created and a startup WARN is logged. See https://github.com/spring-ai-community/spring-ai-agentcore/issues/152.

properties.name: agentcore.memory.session.default-user-id
properties.description: Default user id passed to SessionMemoryAdvisor when the request does not carry chat_memory_user_id. Applies only when agentcore.memory.session.enabled=true. PRECONDITION: AgentCoreSessionRepository derives Session.userId from the actor segment of the sessionId (parsed by AgentCoreMemoryConversationIdParser). Callers that set chat_memory_user_id per-request MUST use sessionId format 'userId:sessionSuffix' where userId equals the value passed under chat_memory_user_id; otherwise the SessionMemoryAdvisor throws IllegalStateException on the second turn (ownership check).

properties.name: agentcore.memory.session.persist-synthetic
properties.description: When true, synthetic session events (framework-generated, e.g. compaction summaries) are persisted to AgentCore via AgentCoreSessionRepository.appendEvent. Default false: synthetic events are skipped because AgentCore stores real dialogue only.

properties.name: agentcore.memory.session.total-events-limit
properties.description: Session-scoped maximum number of events AgentCoreSessionRepository retrieves per session. Applies only when agentcore.memory.session.enabled=true. When null, resolution falls back to agentcore.memory.short-term.total-events-limit, then the legacy agentcore.memory.total-events-limit, then no limit.

properties.name: agentcore.memory.session.page-size
properties.description: Session-scoped page size AgentCoreSessionRepository uses when paginating AgentCore listEvents and listSessions. Applies only when agentcore.memory.session.enabled=true. When null, resolution falls back to agentcore.memory.short-term.page-size, then the legacy agentcore.memory.page-size, then the built-in default.

properties.name: agentcore.memory.session.ignore-unknown-roles
properties.description: Session-scoped switch for silently skipping messages with unsupported roles instead of failing. Applies only when agentcore.memory.session.enabled=true. When null, resolution falls back to agentcore.memory.short-term.ignore-unknown-roles, then the legacy agentcore.memory.ignore-unknown-roles, then true.

properties.name: agentcore.memory.session.default-session
properties.description: Session-scoped default session id used when the conversation id carries no session segment. Applies only when agentcore.memory.session.enabled=true. When null, resolution falls back to agentcore.memory.short-term.default-session, then the legacy agentcore.memory.default-session, then 'default-session'.
